# Ψ-NEXUS: Esoteric Radix, Soul Matrix & Ephemeris Engine
> Ψ-NEXUS is an open, high-precision astronomical and esoteric calculation platform combining VSOP87 planetary ephemerides, Placidus house quadrant calculations, Pythagorean numerology, 7 Rays esoteric psychology, and Vera F. Birkenbihl neurodidactics.

## Core Capabilities & Calculations
- **Planetary Ephemerides:** Bogensekunden-exact celestial coordinates based on VSOP87 & IAU standards (Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Chiron, Lilith, Lunar Nodes).
- **House Systems:** Placidus semi-arc projection with exact pole formulas and Equal house division across all geographic latitudes.
- **Aspect Matrix:** Ptolemaic major aspects (Conjunction, Opposition, Trine, Square, Sextile) with customizable dynamic orbs.
- **Pythagorean Numerology:** Deterministic calculation of Life Path Number (1-9, Master Numbers 11, 22, 33), Soul Urge, Destiny, and Expression numbers.
- **Esoteric Psychology:** Seven Rays analysis after Alice Bailey & Helena Blavatsky; Archetype dialectics after C.G. Jung.
- **Human Design & Synastry:** Integrated Bodygraph archetype mapping and relationship resonance dialectics.
- **Zero-Tracking Privacy:** 100% client-side / offline-first execution; zero transmission of personal birth data to external telemetry servers.
